title: Project paper summary
text: The project studies aggregate behavioral stress regimes using cautious synthetic validation. Keyword signals should represent population-level behavioral shifts, not individual diagnosis. Discretionary contraction, substitution, repair, discount seeking, debt stress, layoffs, and inflation anxiety are candidate digital traces when grounded by context and reviewed by humans.

title: Ontology documentation
text: Ontology categories constrain keyword generation: discretionary contraction; repair vs replacement; discount-seeking; debt stress; layoffs; inflation anxiety; substitution behavior; micro-luxury persistence; regional economic anxiety; and location-specific consumer stress signals. Each keyword requires expected direction under stress, geography, locale, source context, confidence, reason, and review status.

title: Keyword codebook notes
text: Repair versus replacement terms such as appliance repair, phone screen repair, used tires, and fix car are expected to increase when consumers defer replacement. Discount-seeking terms such as coupons, clearance, cheap groceries, price match, and promo code indicate active value search.

title: Historical reports
text: Historical downturn reports often show increased attention to unemployment benefits, layoffs, rent help, debt relief, food bank searches, and lower-cost substitutes. Spikes from news cycles, weather events, or one-off policy announcements require drift review before interpretation.

title: Curated California economic notes
text: California consumer stress notes emphasize rent burden, utility bills, gas prices, grocery affordability, layoffs in technology metros, and searches for repair services in large metros. Google Trends geographic support can vary by metro and low-volume locations should be tracked rather than assumed usable.

title: Validation notes
text: Validation notes require stable geographic codes where possible and explicit flags for unsupported or low-volume locations. RAG context grounds candidate keywords and explanations only. It must not directly decide alerts or bypass human approval.
